day_shape: 63 items dominated by regime-channel coverage of Ali Khamenei's funeral and son Mojtaba's vengeance message, Israeli strikes on Mansouri in south Lebanon, Iran's UN envoy warning on the Islamabad MoU, and IDF strike on Khan Younis; nothing from UK Parliament, State Department or OFAC.

threads.label: Khamenei funeral and mourning coverage
threads.summary: Regime channels ran heavy coverage of the funeral of Ali Khamenei ('Mr Martyr of Iran'), including crowd scenes in Mashhad, Imam Reza shrine ceremonies, and a launch of a new Rahbar.ir information portal for successor Mojtaba Khamenei. The Intelligence Ministry and various officials issued statements thanking mourners in Iran and Iraq for what they called a historic turnout.

threads.label: Mojtaba Khamenei vengeance message
threads.summary: Khamenei's office published a message attributed to new Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei pledging to avenge his father's killing, saying 'criminals' would not die peacefully and that free peoples worldwide would carry out parts of the retribution. The Jerusalem Post reported the pledge, and Defa Press cited a funeral spokesman saying 'revenge' was the first step.

threads.label: Israeli strikes on south Lebanon and Gaza
threads.summary: IRIB and Times of Israel military correspondent Emanuel Fabian reported repeated Israeli airstrikes on the town of Mansouri in the Tyre district of southern Lebanon. IRIB also reported an Israeli airstrike on al-Tina Street south of Khan Younis in Gaza.

threads.label: Iran defence posture and Hormuz
threads.summary: Defence Minister Ibn al-Reza told the Majlis National Security Commission that defence production continued through the recent war and drone output tripled, while a joint image of the Artesh and IRGC navy commanders was published as a Hormuz-cooperation symbol. Defa Press also reported commendation of IRGC Navy commander Ali Azmayi for 'consolidating Iranian arrangements' in the Strait of Hormuz.

threads.label: Iran-US MoU under strain
threads.summary: IRIB reported Iran's UN envoy Iravani warning outside the Security Council that Tehran would not remain bound by the Islamabad MoU if the United States continued violating its commitments. Iran International published an analysis noting the 60-day MoU is running amid a broken ceasefire, renewed attacks on shipping in the Strait of Hormuz, and US strikes on Iran.

threads.label: Iran domestic economy and security
threads.summary: Iran International reported Iran faces the region's harshest combination of wartime economic contraction and inflation, while IRIB covered a temporary interbank network disruption affecting a share of 7,000 banking services. Defa Press reported two Basij members, Sajjad Alavi and Mehdi Honarmand, killed in a Mashhad patrol attack about 15km from the Imam Reza shrine.

threads.label: Syria ISIS cell and regional items
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post, citing Syria's SANA, reported Syrian forces captured an ISIS cell in southern Syria following bombings around Macron's visit earlier in the week. Separately, Judiciary chief Ejei told international lawyers that US and Israeli 'war criminals' should face punishment and pay damages for actions against Iran.
